name: NeoPixel

specs.current: ≈ 60 mA per LED at full white
specs.color_depth: 24-bit (8 per RGB channel) or 32-bit on SK6812 RGBW

pins.label: VCC
pins.note: 5V — beefy supply if you have many LEDs (60 mA each)

pins.label: DIN
pins.note: Add a ~300Ω series resistor; level-shift to 5V if MCU is 3.3V (74AHCT125)

pins.label: DOUT
pins.note: Feeds the next LED's DIN — chain as many as your power supply can handle

tips: Add a 1000 μF capacitor across VCC/GND at the strip input — prevents the inrush spike from killing the first LED.
Level-shift the data line — 3.3V MCUs are borderline for a 5V WS2812; failures are intermittent and maddening.
Disable interrupts during transmission if the MCU is busy — even a few μs of pause corrupts the frame.
First LED is often DEAD on cheap strips — solder a header to feed past it.

alternatives.name: SK6812
alternatives.note: RGBW variant (adds a white channel) — same protocol.

alternatives.name: APA102
alternatives.note: SPI-style two-wire (clock + data) — no timing constraints, more robust on Pi/Linux.
